heading: Implementation Timeline, Client Dependencies, and Billing Commencement
text: Evergrove Software and Lees-McRae College will establish a mutually agreed implementation schedule for each workspace, including anticipated milestones, required institutional participation, testing, and activation. Evergrove will make commercially reasonable efforts to deliver each workspace according to the agreed schedule. The College agrees to provide timely access to necessary personnel, information, systems, approvals, and feedback. If Evergrove has substantially completed the agreed deliverables and the workspace is ready for its intended operational use, but activation is delayed due to institutional scheduling, internal approvals, unavailable personnel, or other circumstances outside Evergrove’s reasonable control, monthly subscription billing will commence 30 calendar days after Evergrove provides written notice of operational readiness. Any outstanding material defects attributable to Evergrove that prevent the workspace’s intended use must be resolved before billing commences under this provision. Delays attributable to Evergrove will not accelerate billing. This provision applies independently to each workspace and does not require simultaneous activation of multiple departments.
